# Changelog

## [1.2.0] — 2026-08-09

### Added

* Added EPUB generation support.
* Added chapter-aware EPUB navigation and table of contents.
* Added chapter title management for translated works.
* Added resumable translation progress tracking.
* Added translation progress verification tools.
* Added support for preserving translation state across interrupted sessions.
* Added additional translation references and workflow documentation.
* Added support for processing and translating larger document workflows more reliably.

### Improved

* Improved document conversion and translation workflow.
* Improved translation progress management and recovery.
* Improved output formatting and final document assembly.
* Improved handling of chapter structure during final EPUB generation.
* Improved documentation and usage guidance.

### Changed

* Updated the translation workflow to provide more reliable progress tracking.
* Updated EPUB output to provide structured chapter navigation suitable for e-readers.

### Compatibility

* Existing translation projects can continue using the standard workflow.
* No changes to the core translation prompt or translation methodology are required.
